worked_solution:
Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}7 & 12 \\ -20 & -6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}7\cdot 1+12\cdot 0 & 7\cdot 0+12\cdot 1 \\ -20\cdot 1+(-6)\cdot 0 & -20\cdot 0+(-6)\cdot 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7+0 & 0+12 \\ -20+0 & 0+(-6)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}7 & 12 \\ -20 & -6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
